finding.title: Stop using app_localizations_coverage_test.dart's 1482 zero-assertion lines to pad the CI coverage floor over generated l10n code
finding.rule: TQ-8 / Rule 0 (coverage floor's stated generated-file exclusion is unenforced)

evidence.quote: return paths. No assertion is made on the text — the goal is line coverage of the generated translation strings.

finding.why: grep -c 'expect(' on the file returns 0 — in 1482 lines, nothing can ever fail except a compile error (e.g. a renamed getter), which would abort the whole file rather than flag the specific key. The file's own docstring admits its purpose is purely to drive line-execution through lib/l10n/app_localizations_en.dart and _he.dart (5100+ generated lines each) for the CI-enforced coverage floor. docs/coding-standards.md states the 60% line-coverage floor is measured with 'generated files excluded', but .github/workflows/ci.yml's coverage-floor step runs `lcov --summary` directly on the raw lcov.info with no `lcov --remove` step anywhere in the repo (verified: no lcov --remove/genhtml exclude pattern exists in Makefile or ci.yml) — so generated files are NOT excluded in practice, and this file's 725-getter roll call launders thousands of auto-generated, logic-free lines into the numerator that the doc claims shouldn't count. Concrete cost: every new l10n key needs a manual line added here (already 725, and easy to forget silently since forgetting produces no failure), for a test that cannot catch a wrong translation, a missing plural case, or the exact ARB duplicate-key bug found elsewhere in this batch.
finding.recommendation: Either (a) wire the promised exclusion into the CI coverage step (lcov --remove coverage/lcov.info 'lib/l10n/app_localizations_*.dart' '*.g.dart' ... before lcov --summary) and delete this file, or (b) if kept for its doc-verification role, replace the per-getter roll call with a real check (e.g. that every ARB key has a corresponding generated getter) instead of 1482 lines that assert nothing.
acceptance_criteria: CI's coverage-floor step excludes generated files from the denominator (matching the doc's claim) OR this file is deleted/replaced with an assertive test.
docs/coding-standards.md's 'generated files excluded' claim matches what .github/workflows/ci.yml actually does.

finding.title: Delete the dead nullService ternary in sy2_device_restore_idle_blank_test.dart's _buildHarness

evidence.quote: : null, // always null — no service needed for these tests

finding.why: `nullService ? null : null` evaluates to null on both branches — the nullService bool parameter has zero effect on behavior, yet every call site passes `nullService: true` as if it mattered. A future maintainer who needs a non-null-service variant of this harness will reasonably flip it to `nullService: false` expecting different behavior and get nothing, wasting debugging time on a flag that was already inert.
finding.recommendation: Delete the nullService parameter and the ternary; pass deviceRestoreServiceProvider.overrideWithValue(null) directly, matching the comment's own admission of actual behavior.
acceptance_criteria: nullService parameter and the dead ternary are removed from _buildHarness; dart analyze / dart format stay clean.

finding.title: Extract the duplicated router/guard mock harness out of 4 test/app/restore/*_test.dart files into one shared helper
finding.rule: TQ-3 (shared pump/harness helper) / Fowler duplicated code
finding.why: _MockStackRouter, _MockRestoreGuard, _StubAppRouter, and the _makeRouter()/_buildHarness() pattern (ProviderScope overrides for restoreStatusProvider, deviceRestoreServiceProvider, routerProvider, userDatabaseProvider, currentAccountIdProvider, selectedProfileIdProvider wrapped in a MaterialApp with the same localizationsDelegates list) are copy-pasted near-byte-identically across all 4 restore test files in this batch — confirmed via direct text comparison, not just naming. The project already has a `pumpApp` helper convention used elsewhere (test/e2e/journeys/*), and test/helpers/ has no equivalent for this restore-specific harness, so each new restore test file re-derives it from scratch. Concrete cost: a change to AppRouter's or RestoreGuard's interface (e.g. a new method the screen calls) requires editing the same stub in 4+ places; the next restore test file will likely paste a 5th copy, and any router-mocking bug fixed in one copy silently persists in the other three.
finding.recommendation: Extract a shared test/app/restore/restore_test_harness.dart (or add to test/helpers/) exposing the mock classes, _makeRouter()/_makeAppRouter(), and a parameterized _buildHarness()/pumpApp()-style entry point; have all 4 files import it instead of redefining it.
acceptance_criteria: A single shared helper file defines _MockStackRouter/_MockRestoreGuard/_StubAppRouter and the harness builder.

The 4 files in this batch (device_restore_phase_l10n_test.dart, device_restore_screen_l1_test.dart, device_restore_screen_overflow_test.dart, sy2_device_restore_idle_blank_test.dart) import it instead of each defining their own copy; grep for 'class _MockStackRouter' across test/app/restore/ returns exactly one hit.

finding.title: Extract the duplicated ARB-loading helper out of 4 test/l10n regression tests
finding.rule: Fowler lens — duplicated code; no numbered TQ rule, but violates this repo's own test/helpers/ convention
finding.why: Each file hand-rolls its own private _loadArb (or inlines the equivalent) instead of using the test/helpers/ pattern already established by test_database.dart, firestore_fake.dart, etc. The copies have already drifted: 2 of the 4 (hebrew_shabbos_strings_il9_test.dart, icu_plural_il3_test.dart) gained a `../lib/l10n/...` CWD-fallback candidate list, while b1_vocab_keys_present_test.dart and no_hardcoded_percent_in_chart_subtitle_test.dart still resolve only a single hardcoded path. If the test-invocation CWD convention ever changes (different `flutter test` working directory in CI, a monorepo restructure, running a single file from an IDE rooted elsewhere), half these tests fail with an unhelpful 'file must exist' error while the other half quietly cope — proof the duplication isn't being kept in sync today, let alone as more l10n regression tests get added (a 5th copy already exists in test/l10n/account_picker_subtitle_copy_test.dart, outside this batch).
finding.recommendation: Extract one `Map<String, dynamic> loadArb(String locale)` helper (using the two-candidate CWD-fallback) into a new test/helpers/arb_loader.dart, and have every test/l10n/*_test.dart import it instead of defining/inlining its own copy.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/arb_loader.dart exists and is the single definition of ARB-loading logic used by test/l10n/*_test.dart
grep -rn "_loadArb(String locale)\|final file = File('lib/l10n/app_" learning_tracker/test/l10n/*.dart outside test/helpers/ returns zero matches (usable as a Rule-0 grep checker)

finding.title: Drop or wire up dead ARB keys milestoneAggregate/recentActivityShort pinned by b1_vocab_keys_present_test.dart
finding.rule: AG-6-adjacent dead code / Evans ubiquitous language (vocabulary the app doesn't actually speak)
finding.why: grep -rn '\bmilestoneAggregate\b' and '\brecentActivityShort\b' across lib/ match only the generated lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart files — no screen or widget calls either getter. This test locks both into the ARB contract forever, and a sibling test's comment (test/core/labels/domain_term_labels_vocab_test.dart:114-116: 'milestone, milestoneAggregate, ... — removed from DomainTermLabels ... tested through widget-level integration tests, not here') claims coverage that doesn't exist for these two keys, so translators keep maintaining EN/HE strings nobody reads and nothing actually exercises the values this test pins.
finding.recommendation: Either wire milestoneAggregate/recentActivityShort into the screen(s) they were written for, or delete them from both ARBs, this test's _b1VocabKeys list, and the stale comment in domain_term_labels_vocab_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn '\bmilestoneAggregate\b\|\brecentActivityShort\b' lib/ --include=*.dart shows a call site outside lib/l10n/, OR both keys are removed from app_en.arb, app_he.arb, and this test's _b1VocabKeys list
